text.en: Sixty-four sports of Lord Shiva at Madurai in verse.

Thiruvilaiyadal Puranam, composed by Paranjothi Munivar, narrates the sixty-four divine sports (திருவிளையாடல்கள்) of Lord Shiva at Madurai. The memorisation poem in the textbook is from this epic.
The poems show devotion and rich storytelling about Madurai. Read the poem and learn its meaning.
Terms: புராணம், திருவிளையாடல் (divine sport), மதுரை and பரஞ்சோதி முனிவர்.
